SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO

GO

CREATE PROC [BNKM].[SP_CURRENCYCONVERSION_GLD] AS
BEGIN

WITH TEMP_BNKM_CurrencyConversion AS
(
	SELECT
		BGR.FXD_CRNCY_CODE AS ConvertFromCurrencyId
		,BGR.VAR_CRNCY_CODE AS ConvertToCurrencyId
		,'FCBS Currency Conversion Rate' AS ExchangeRateTypeId
		,0 AS QuotingPartyId
		,BGR.RTLIST_DATE AS CurrencyConversionTimestamp
		,BGR.VAR_CRNCY_UNITS AS ConversionRate
		,NULL AS CurrencyAgio
		,NULL AS ConvertFromCurrencyCleanFloatIndicator
		,CASE WHEN BGR.FXD_CRNCY_CODE <> 'PHP' AND BGR.VAR_CRNCY_CODE <> 'PHP' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS ConvertFromCurrencyCrossDealIndicator
		,CASE WHEN BGR.RATECODE IN ('BSP') THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS ConvertFromCurrencyFixedExchangeRateIndicator
		,BGR.RTLIST_NUM AS RateListNumber
		,BGR.RATECODE AS RateId
		,BGR.BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId
		,BGR.DEL_FLG AS DeletedIndicator
		,BGR.FXD_CRNCY_UNITS AS FixedCurrencyUnits
		,'GLD' AS SourceCode
		,0 AS WorkFlowId
		,0 AS TaskRunId
		,insert_dttm AS InsertDttm
		,RECORD_STATUS
	FROM BUSC.GLD_RATELIST_HIST_TABLE_DELTA BGRD
	LEFT JOIN BUSC.GLD_RATELIST_HIST_TABLE BGR
		ON BGRD.RTLIST_DATE = BGR.RTLIST_DATE 
		AND BGRD.RTLIST_NUM = BGR.RTLIST_NUM 
		AND BGRD.FXD_CRNCY_CODE = BGR.FXD_CRNCY_CODE 
		AND BGRD.VAR_CRNCY_CODE = BGR.VAR_CRNCY_CODE 
		AND BGRD.RATECODE = BGR.RATECODE 
		AND BGRD.BANK_ID = BGR.BANK_ID
		AND BGR.isLatest = 1
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CurrencyConversion FROM TEMP_BNKM_CurrencyConversion;

WITH TEMP_BNKM_CurrencyConversion_SRC AS
(
	SELECT
		HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
			ConvertFromCurrencyId
			,ConvertToCurrencyId
			,ExchangeRateTypeId
			,QuotingPartyId
			,CurrencyConversionTimestamp
			,ConversionRate
			,CurrencyAgio
			,ConvertFromCurrencyCleanFloatIndicator
			,ConvertFromCurrencyCrossDealIndicator
			,ConvertFromCurrencyFixedExchangeRateIndicator
			,RateListNumber
			,RateId
			,DeletedIndicator
			,FixedCurrencyUnits)) AS HASHROW
			,ConvertFromCurrencyId ,ConvertToCurrencyId ,CurrencyConversionTimestamp ,RECORD_STATUS
	FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CurrencyConversion
	WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'

), 

TEMP_BNKM_CurrencyConversion_TGT AS
(
	SELECT
		HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
			ConvertFromCurrencyId
			,ConvertToCurrencyId
			,ExchangeRateTypeId
			,QuotingPartyId
			,CurrencyConversionTimestamp
			,ConversionRate
			,CurrencyAgio
			,ConvertFromCurrencyCleanFloatIndicator
			,ConvertFromCurrencyCrossDealIndicator
			,ConvertFromCurrencyFixedExchangeRateIndicator
			,RateListNumber
			,RateId
			,DeletedIndicator
			,FixedCurrencyUnits)) AS HASHROW
			,ConvertFromCurrencyId ,ConvertToCurrencyId ,CurrencyConversionTimestamp
	FROM BNKM.CurrencyConversion
	WHERE SourceCode = 'GLD'
),

TEMP_BNKM_CurrencyConversion_DELTA AS
(
	SELECT	
		SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
		,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
		,ISNULL(SRC.ConvertFromCurrencyId,TGT.ConvertFromCurrencyId) AS ConvertFromCurrencyId
		,ISNULL(SRC.ConvertToCurrencyId,TGT.ConvertToCurrencyId) AS ConvertToCurrencyId
		,ISNULL(SRC.CurrencyConversionTimestamp,TGT.CurrencyConversionTimestamp) AS CurrencyConversionTimestamp
		,CASE
			WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
		ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	FROM TEMP_BNKM_CurrencyConversion_SRC SRC
	LEFT JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CurrencyConversion_TGT TGT
		ON SRC.ConvertFromCurrencyId = TGT.ConvertFromCurrencyId
		AND SRC.ConvertToCurrencyId = TGT.ConvertToCurrencyId
		AND SRC.CurrencyConversionTimestamp = TGT.CurrencyConversionTimestamp
	WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW  
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CurrencyConversion_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CurrencyConversion_DELTA;

UPDATE TGT
SET 
	ConvertFromCurrencyId = SRC.ConvertFromCurrencyId
	,ConvertToCurrencyId = SRC.ConvertToCurrencyId
	,ExchangeRateTypeId = SRC.ExchangeRateTypeId
	,QuotingPartyId = SRC.QuotingPartyId
	,CurrencyConversionTimestamp = SRC.CurrencyConversionTimestamp
	,ConversionRate = SRC.ConversionRate
	,CurrencyAgio = SRC.CurrencyAgio
	,ConvertFromCurrencyCleanFloatIndicator = SRC.ConvertFromCurrencyCleanFloatIndicator
	,ConvertFromCurrencyCrossDealIndicator = SRC.ConvertFromCurrencyCrossDealIndicator
	,ConvertFromCurrencyFixedExchangeRateIndicator = SRC.ConvertFromCurrencyFixedExchangeRateIndicator
	,RateListNumber = SRC.RateListNumber
	,RateId = SRC.RateId
	,FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
	,DeletedIndicator = SRC.DeletedIndicator
	,FixedCurrencyUnits = SRC.FixedCurrencyUnits
	,SourceCode = SRC.SourceCode
	,WorkFlowId = SRC.WorkFlowId
	,TaskRunId = SRC.TaskRunId
	,InsertDttm = SRC.InsertDttm
FROM BNKM.CurrencyConversion TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CurrencyConversion_DELTA DELTA
	ON DELTA.ConvertFromCurrencyId = TGT.ConvertFromCurrencyId
	AND DELTA.ConvertToCurrencyId = TGT.ConvertToCurrencyId
	AND DELTA.CurrencyConversionTimestamp = TGT.CurrencyConversionTimestamp
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CurrencyConversion SRC
	ON SRC.ConvertFromCurrencyId = TGT.ConvertFromCurrencyId
	AND SRC.ConvertToCurrencyId = TGT.ConvertToCurrencyId
	AND SRC.CurrencyConversionTimestamp = TGT.CurrencyConversionTimestamp ;


INSERT INTO BNKM.CurrencyConversion
	(ConvertFromCurrencyId
	,ConvertToCurrencyId
	,ExchangeRateTypeId
	,QuotingPartyId
	,CurrencyConversionTimestamp
	,ConversionRate
	,CurrencyAgio
	,ConvertFromCurrencyCleanFloatIndicator
	,ConvertFromCurrencyCrossDealIndicator
	,ConvertFromCurrencyFixedExchangeRateIndicator
	,RateListNumber
	,RateId
	,FinancialInstitutionId
	,DeletedIndicator
	,FixedCurrencyUnits
	,SourceCode
	,WorkFlowId
	,TaskRunId
	,InsertDttm)
SELECT 
	ConvertFromCurrencyId
	,ConvertToCurrencyId
	,ExchangeRateTypeId
	,QuotingPartyId
	,CurrencyConversionTimestamp
	,ConversionRate
	,CurrencyAgio
	,ConvertFromCurrencyCleanFloatIndicator
	,ConvertFromCurrencyCrossDealIndicator
	,ConvertFromCurrencyFixedExchangeRateIndicator
	,RateListNumber
	,RateId
	,FinancialInstitutionId
	,DeletedIndicator
	,FixedCurrencyUnits
	,SourceCode
	,WorkFlowId
	,TaskRunId
	,InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CurrencyConversion
WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'INSERT'

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CurrencyConversion;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CurrencyConversion_DELTA;

END
GO
